title: Rabbi Chanina of Ono
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in the [Mishnah Gittin 6:7](https://www.sefaria.org/Mishnah_Gittin.6.7): “This halakhah Rabbi Chanina of Ono brought up from prison” (in the name of Rabbi Akiva, who was imprisoned — [Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Gittin.66b.2.1)). In [Gittin 67a](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.67a.6): “Rabbi Shimon son of Rabbi said before Rabbi: Since Rabbi Meir and Chanina of Ono disagree,” etc. In [Sanhedrin 11b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.11b.8): Hyman quotes Chananyah of Ono as testifying that if they intercalated the year in the Galilee, it is intercalated. He is likewise mentioned in [Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 6:8](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Nedarim.6.8.12).[^1]

notes.text: Rashi identifies the imprisoned teacher as Rabbi Akiva. The linked Sanhedrin gives validity in the preceding ruling but has Chananyah testify that a year intercalated in the Galilee is invalid. The linked Yerushalmi attributes to Chananyah permission to intercalate there when it cannot be done in Judea.
